svg.title: Skyline Care Services interior painting portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional painting portfolio concept for Skyline Care Services, showing a freshly completed olive living-room accent wall with crisp trim. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
